title: Wise Words
subtitle: WITH MARCO REYES  ·  STORY NIGHT

segments.head: TONIGHT: THE TRAINEE
segments.author: Wise Words
lines: Good evening, everyone.
I'm Marco Reyes, and this is Wise Words.
Tonight's story is about Kimo Akana, a propane delivery driver in Hilo, Hawaii.
For nineteen years, Kimo drove alone. He liked it.
Then his boss handed him a trainee. She was sixty-one.

segments.head: CHAPTER 1: THE KEYS
segments.quote: The best way to find out if you can trust somebody is to trust them.
segments.author: Ernest Hemingway
lines: Florence was a retired librarian who wanted one more adventure.
Kimo groaned. She'll scratch my truck.
His boss tapped a note on her desk, from Ernest Hemingway:
The best way to find out if you can trust somebody is to trust them.
So Kimo handed Florence the keys.

segments.head: CHAPTER 2: THE MAILBOX
segments.quote: I have always found that mercy bears richer fruits than strict justice.
segments.author: Abraham Lincoln
lines: On day three, Florence backed into a customer's mailbox. Crunch.
Kimo started to yell. Then he remembered a line from Abraham Lincoln:
I have always found that mercy bears richer fruits than strict justice.
So he laughed, grabbed a hammer, and they fixed it together.
Florence never hit another thing.

segments.head: CHAPTER 3: NICE PARKING
segments.quote: I can live for two months on a good compliment.
segments.author: Mark Twain
lines: A week later, she parked on a steep hill. Perfect.
Kimo just grunted. Florence smiled. Mark Twain once said:
I can live for two months on a good compliment.
Kimo cleared his throat. Beautiful parking, he said. She glowed all day.

segments.head: CHAPTER 4: THE TALKER
segments.quote: There is no such thing on earth as an uninteresting subject; the only thing that can exist is an uninterested person.
segments.author: G. K. Chesterton
lines: But Florence was slow. At every stop, she chatted with the customers.
Kimo tapped his watch. It's a gas tank, Florence.
She showed him a line by G. K. Chesterton, an English writer:
There is no such thing on earth as an uninteresting subject; the only thing that can exist is an uninterested person.
So Kimo asked old Mr. Kahale about his orchids. He'd never been so late, or so happy.

segments.head: CHAPTER 5: THE BACK ROAD
segments.quote: It is the province of knowledge to speak, and it is the privilege of wisdom to listen.
segments.author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.
lines: Then a storm closed the highway, and twelve farm families needed gas.
Florence said, I know a back road. I read every old map.
Kimo started to argue. Then he thought of Oliver Wendell Holmes, the American writer:
It is the province of knowledge to speak, and it is the privilege of wisdom to listen.
So he listened. Every family got a hot dinner.

segments.head: CHAPTER 6: THE CAKE
segments.quote: Those who bring sunshine into the lives of others cannot keep it from themselves.
segments.author: J. M. Barrie
lines: In March, Florence finished training. Nobody knew it was her birthday. Except Kimo.
He thought of J. M. Barrie, the man who wrote Peter Pan:
Those who bring sunshine into the lives of others cannot keep it from themselves.
So he brought a cake shaped like a propane tank.
Now Kimo trains every new driver. He says it's for them. His boss knows better.

segments.head: THAT'S TONIGHT'S STORY
segments.quote: Trust first. Show mercy. Say the nice thing. Get curious. Listen. Share the sunshine.
segments.author: Marco Reyes
lines: That's tonight's story.
Trust first. Show mercy. Say the nice thing. Get curious. Listen. Share the sunshine.
I drove a big truck once. I parked it on my own lawn. Nobody gave me a compliment.
I'm Marco Reyes. Good night.
